description: Empirical-Bayes Gaussian hidden Markov model for binned single-molecule FRET time traces (ebFRET/vbFRET-style), with a state-count scan, per-state emission recovery, and Viterbi dwell/transition analysis. Complements the photon-by-photon H2MM plugin for TIRF-style intensity-vs-time data.
experimental_message: Experimental headless port of ebFRET's per-trace VBEM + empirical-Bayes hyperparameter loop. Validated for state recovery against ebFRET's own simulated-K04-N350 dataset; the single-prior (non-mixture) D=1 path only, and no GUI tool yet.

rpc_methods.name: burst_ebfret.jobs.compute
rpc_methods.summary: Fit an empirical-Bayes Gaussian HMM over a set of binned FRET traces.
